channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI, Tech & Research, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI, Tech & Research, Africa, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 08 Jun 2026 (08 Jun to 14 Jun 2026).

  • ARUA: Early-Career Research Fellowships 2026 (Option 2)
    African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA), with the Mastercard Foundation and Carnegie Corporation of New York · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 2,000, a modest accommodation payment, and travel support (return ticket to host institution). 6-month fellowship.
  • Cambridge-Africa: ALBORADA Research Fund 2026
    Cambridge-Africa Programme, University of Cambridge (supported by The ALBORADA Trust) · deadline 03 Sep 2026 · Competitive grants of GBP 1,000 to 25,000. Covers research costs such as reagents, fieldwork, equipment and research-training activities in Africa (e.g. sett...
